sensor: VIIRS NOAA-20 Corrected Reflectance + VIIRS Deep Blue L2 weak labels

training_data.label_policy: positive cells are rasterized from VIIRS Deep Blue L2 native footprint mask; negatives are unlabeled AOI grid cells

confidence.reason: A local learned pixel classifier was trained on current-AOI VIIRS corrected-reflectance RGB features using VIIRS Deep Blue L2 footprint weak labels; validation is spatial holdout inside the same AOI.

provenance.data_source: VIIRS NOAA-20 Corrected Reflectance; weak labels from VIIRS Deep Blue AERDB_L2 native footprints
limitations: This is a local weak-label learned baseline, not Element84 public weights.
Labels come from VIIRS Deep Blue threshold footprints, not human semantic segmentation masks.
Validation is a spatial holdout inside the same AOI and should not be reported as independent generalization.
Use as a model-inference bridge until Dust-Mamba or a public VIIRS segmentation checkpoint is available.

display_policy: Show as an executed current-AOI learned model baseline with weak-label provenance. Do not claim it is Dust-Mamba or Element84 public model inference.
